_comment: Sub-national units (states, provinces) and territories without an ISO 3166-1 code. key = PARENT_ISO3 + '-' + ISO 3166-2 subdivision suffix (e.g. ISO 3166-2 'US-CA' -> 'USA-CA'). Add entries before importing data for them. Example entry: {"key":"USA-CA","name":"California","type":"subnational","parent":"USA","aliases":["US-CA","California"]}
